params.prompt: professional e-commerce product photo of a matte white glazed ceramic coffee mug with a slim handle, glazed ceramic surface with a soft sheen, on a seamless light grey background, three-point studio lighting, key light with fill and rim, subject filling about 70% of the frame, centered, even margin, sharp focus, high detail, commercial grade, 8k
params.negative_prompt: low resolution, blurry, out of focus, deformed structure, distorted outline, wrong proportions, extra parts, missing parts, melted edges, watermark, logo, text in image, cluttered background, floating without support

notes: 默认放大 1.5x；denoise 0.3 保住釉面细节。⚠️ 放大后的**画质增益是否成立尚未实测**（debug_log §2.7 待验证 ②）—— 本用例不声称画质达标
